params.caption: 🎮 WoW: Forever ends dungeon boosting for low-level players Dungeon enemies in WoW: Forever no longer give any experience if they are trivial for even one member of the party. That shuts down the old trick of bringing a high-level friend along to carry you through a dungeon for fast levels. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 01:17 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 👥 @Warcraft · @Blizzard_Ent 👍 Good change or 👎 too harsh? 💬 Tell us how you level #WorldOfWarcraft #WoWForever #Blizzard #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
